procedural_issues_en: The itemized statement was received 3 days after the computed return deadline. Under CT-47a-21-d2, a violation of the return/itemization requirement can expose the landlord to double the deposit ($8,600 based on the supplied facts). Consider confirming any claim with a local tenant-rights group or lawyer.

The statement's refund arithmetic excludes accrued interest: it returns the deposit less deductions only, while the supplied computed interest is $21.01. CT-47a-21-d2 and CT-47a-21-i address the return of accrued interest.

The lease says the deposit is held in escrow, but the materials do not establish whether the landlord provided the separate written escrow notice naming the financial institution and its address within 30 days. Check for that notice under CT-47a-21-h4. The deposit amount is not above the supplied cap.
procedural_issues_ko: 항목별 공제 명세서가 계산된 반환 기한보다 3일 늦게 도착했습니다. CT-47a-21-d2에 따르면 반환·항목별 통지 요건 위반 시 보증금의 두 배(제공된 계산 기준 8,600달러) 책임이 발생할 수 있습니다. 청구를 진행하기 전 지역 세입자 권리 단체나 변호사에게 확인하세요.
환불 계산에는 이자가 포함되지 않은 것으로 보입니다. 공제액만 빼서 보증금을 반환했으며, 제공된 계산상 미지급 이자는 21.01달러입니다. CT-47a-21-d2 및 CT-47a-21-i는 발생 이자 반환을 다룹니다.
계약서에는 보증금을 에스크로에 보관한다고 되어 있지만, 금융기관의 이름과 주소를 적은 별도 서면 통지가 30일 이내에 제공되었는지는 자료로 확인되지 않습니다. CT-47a-21-h4에 따른 통지가 있었는지 확인하세요. 제공된 보증금 한도는 초과하지 않았습니다.

ruling.ruling_en: I approve a $62.40 deduction for the final water/sewer bill and reject the other deductions on this record. The resulting deposit balance is $4,237.60; adding the supplied $21.01 accrued interest, the refund requested is $4,258.61. The itemized statement was received on August 24, 2027, three days after the supplied August 21 deadline; CT-47a-21-d2 may expose the landlord to double-deposit liability for a violation, subject to legal confirmation. Because that potential claim is substantial, have a local tenant-rights group or lawyer review it before pursuing it.
ruling.ruling_ko: 최종 수도·하수도 요금 62.40달러만 공제로 인정하고 나머지 공제는 현재 자료로 인정하지 않습니다. 보증금 잔액은 4,237.60달러이며, 제공된 미지급 이자 21.01달러를 더한 환급 요청액은 4,258.61달러입니다. 항목별 명세서는 제공된 기한인 2027년 8월 21일보다 3일 늦은 8월 24일에 도착했습니다. CT-47a-21-d2에 따라 위반 시 보증금의 두 배 책임이 발생할 수 있으나 법률 전문가의 확인이 필요합니다. 잠재적 청구액이 크므로 진행 전 지역 세입자 권리 단체나 변호사에게 검토받으세요.
ruling.letter_en:
Subject: Security deposit accounting and refund request

Dear Landlord,

I am writing about the security deposit for my tenancy, which ended July 31, 2027. I provided my forwarding address on July 31, 2027. The itemized statement was received August 24, 2027, after the supplied August 21, 2027 return deadline.

I accept a $62.40 deduction for “Final water/sewer bill (Conservice),” consistent with lease p. 2 and CT-47a-21-a14. I dispute the remaining deductions:

- “Living room floor plank replacement”: Rentrail evidence IDs 2 and 12 show the same gouge at move-in and move-out; it was pre-existing. Lease p. 3; CT-47a-21-a14 and CT-47a-11.
- “Hallway wall patch and repaint near light switch”: Rentrail evidence IDs 4 and 14 show the same hole at move-in and move-out. Lease p. 3; CT-47a-21-a14 and CT-47a-11.
- “Bedroom wall crack repair and repaint”: Rentrail evidence ID 20 does not clearly establish an actual crack or tenant-caused damage. Lease p. 3; CT-47a-21-a14 and CT-47a-11.
- “Professional carpet cleaning”: The record does not establish that cleaning was needed or that I failed to keep the unit reasonably clean. Lease p. 3; CT-47a-21-a14 and CT-47a-11.
- “Rekeying - unreturned key”: Please provide evidence that a key was not returned and documentation of the actual reasonable lock-change cost. Lease p. 1; CT-47a-21-a14.

After the accepted $62.40 deduction, the deposit balance is $4,237.60. Adding the supplied accrued interest of $21.01 under CT-47a-21-d2 and CT-47a-21-i, please pay me the refund of $4,258.61. The statement arrived three days after the supplied deadline; CT-47a-21-d2 addresses the return and itemization deadline and potential liability for a violation. Please also provide any written escrow notice required by CT-47a-21-h4, if it was sent.

Please send the $4,258.61 refund and reply to this letter within 10 days. I reserve my rights under CT-47a-21-g. I am willing to resolve this promptly and ask that you provide the supporting bill or records for any amount you continue to claim.

Sincerely,
[PERSON_1]
ruling.letter_ko_summary: 임대인에게 4,258.61달러 환급을 요청하고, 최종 수도·하수도 요금 62.40달러만 인정한다는 서한입니다. 나머지 공제는 관련 Rentrail 증거 ID, 계약서 페이지 및 법 조항을 들어 다툽니다. 늦은 명세서와 에스크로 통지 문제도 언급하고, 10일 이내 회신을 요청합니다.
